plan.title: PRA-ASN-004 Assign option hidden without permission

args.need: sign in as the buyer without PR assign permission and leave the session ready to open Purchase Requisitions

steps.note: The catalog cannot change to or authenticate as a user with the specified permission profile.
Open the Purchase Requisitions screen as the permission-restricted buyer.
Stay on the Open tab where PR-1 can be selected.
Select the specified purchase requisition item before checking assignment controls.
Assert that the Assign button is not offered to this user.
Attempt to express that the Assignee field is unavailable, though the catalog cannot directly verify non-clickability of a table cell.
